titleTh: ทำบัตรนักศึกษาใหม่แทนใบที่หาย
scenarioSentences: You lost your student card yesterday.
You need it for the library.
Ms. Park works at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello, Ms. Park. I lost my student card yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Park
dialogue.text: Oh no. Do you want a new one?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, please. I need it for the library.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Park
dialogue.text: No problem. Please fill in this form first.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Do I need a new photo?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Park
dialogue.text: Yes. We can take it here. Look at the camera, please.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is there a fee for the new card?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Park
dialogue.text: Yes, it is ten dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here you are. When can I get it?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Park
dialogue.text: Come back on Friday afternoon. It will be ready.

titleTh: ซื้อบัตรรถเมล์รายเดือน
scenarioSentences: You take the bus to school.
Your friend Tom has a pass.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Tom, you have a monthly bus pass, right?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Yes. It's cheaper than buying a ticket every time.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Forty dollars a month for students.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I pay about sixty dollars a month now.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Then get the pass. You can save twenty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good idea. Where can I buy one?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: At the ticket office in the bus station. Bring your student card.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll go there after class today.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Great. It's open until six.

titleTh: สั่งเค้กวันเกิดให้รูมเมต
scenarioSentences: Your roommate's birthday is on Saturday.
You go to a small bakery.
You want to order a cake.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello, Mr. Sato. I'd like to order a birthday cake.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Sato
dialogue.text: Of course. What kind of cake would you like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Chocolate, please. It's for my roommate.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Sato
dialogue.text: Nice. What size? We have small and large.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Small, please. It's for four people.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Sato
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you want a name on top?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Her name is Emma.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Sato
dialogue.text: No problem. When do you need it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: On Saturday morning. Can I pick it up at ten?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Sato
dialogue.text: Yes, it will be ready at ten. It's twenty dollars.

titleEn: Asking a neighbor to water plants
titleTh: ฝากเพื่อนบ้านรดน้ำต้นไม้
scenarioSentences: You are going away this weekend.
You have many plants at home.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Mrs. Lopez. Can I ask you a favor?

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Lopez
dialogue.text: Of course. What is it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I'm visiting my family this weekend. Could you water my plants?

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Lopez
dialogue.text: Sure, I can do that. How many plants do you have?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Six. They're all in the living room.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Lopez
dialogue.text: Okay. How much water do they need?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Just one glass each, in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Lopez
dialogue.text: That's easy. But how can I get in?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here's my key. I'll come back on Sunday night.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Lopez
dialogue.text: Great. Have a nice trip!

titleTh: สมัครเรียนว่ายน้ำที่สระ
scenarioSentences: You want to learn to swim.
The school has a swimming pool.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Coach Rivera. Do you have classes for beginners?

dialogue.speaker: Coach Rivera
dialogue.text: Yes. There's one on Tuesday and one on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What time are they?

dialogue.speaker: Coach Rivera
dialogue.text: Tuesday at six p.m. and Friday at seven a.m.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Tuesday is better. I have class on Friday mornings.

dialogue.speaker: Coach Rivera
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll put your name on the Tuesday list.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. What do I need to bring?

dialogue.speaker: Coach Rivera
dialogue.text: A towel and a swim cap.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I don't have a swim cap.

dialogue.speaker: Coach Rivera
dialogue.text: You can buy one at the pool shop. It's five dollars.

titleTh: จองคิวตัดผม
scenarioSentences: Your hair is very long now.
You want to book a time.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Kate. I'd like to book a haircut, please.

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.text: Sure. What kind of haircut do you want?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A short one. My hair is too long now.

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.text: Okay. A short cut is twenty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's fine. Are you free on Wednesday?

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.text: Sorry, we're busy all day Wednesday. How about Thursday?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thursday is okay. Do you have a time after three?

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm free at four o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. Please book me for Thursday at four.

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.text: Done. See you on Thursday!

titleEn: Returning a shirt that is too small
titleTh: เปลี่ยนเสื้อที่เล็กเกินไป
scenarioSentences: You bought a shirt last week.
It is too small for you.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Ben. I bought this shirt here last week.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: Okay. Is there a problem with it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. It's too small. I'd like to change it.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: No problem. Do you have the receipt?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, here it is.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: Thanks. What size is it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's a medium. Do you have a large?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: Let me check. Yes, we have a large in blue.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Can I change it for the large one?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: Of course. Here you are. It's the same price.

titleTh: แจ้งฝักบัวในหอเสีย
scenarioSentences: Your shower has no hot water.
Mr. Grant is the dorm manager.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello, Mr. Grant. My shower is broken.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Grant
dialogue.text: Oh, I'm sorry. What's wrong with it?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: There's only cold water. It started two days ago.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Grant
dialogue.text: What's your room number?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Room 305, on the third floor.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Grant
dialogue.text: Okay. Someone can fix it tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Tomorrow? What can I do tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Grant
dialogue.text: You can use the shower on the second floor. It works well.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, thank you. Do I need to be in my room tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Grant
dialogue.text: No. I have a key. I'll let him in.

titleTh: ตามหาร่มที่ลืมไว้
scenarioSentences: You had lunch in the cafeteria.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me, Amy. I think I left my umbrella here.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Oh no. When were you here?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: At lunch, about twelve o'clock. I sat near the window.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: What does your umbrella look like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's blue with white stars.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Let me look in the lost and found box.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. It was a present from my mom.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Is this it? Someone found it on a chair.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, that's mine! Thank you so much.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Don't forget it again!

titleTh: วางแผนไปปิกนิกวันหยุด
scenarioSentences: The weather is nice this week.
You want to have a picnic.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Lily. Do you want to have a picnic on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Yes! Where do you want to go?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What about the big park near the river?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Nice. What time can we meet?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Let's meet at eleven at the park gate.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Okay. What food do we need?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I can make sandwiches. Can you bring some fruit and drinks?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Sure. But what if it rains?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Then we can eat at my place and play cards.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Sounds good. See you at eleven!

titleTh: ทำความรู้จักรูมเมตคนใหม่
scenarioSentences: You moved into a dorm today.
You want to be good roommates.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Jun. Nice to meet you. What do you study?

dialogue.speaker: Jun
dialogue.text: Art. My classes are in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Mine start at eight, so I go to bed at eleven.

dialogue.speaker: Jun
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll be quiet after eleven.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. And can we share the fridge?

dialogue.speaker: Jun
dialogue.text: Sure. You take the top shelf, and I'll take the bottom.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good. Let's clean the room together on Sundays, too.

dialogue.speaker: Jun
dialogue.text: Fine with me.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Quiet after eleven, and cleaning on Sundays.

dialogue.speaker: Jun
dialogue.text: Yes. I think we'll be good roommates.

titleTh: ถามทางไปไปรษณีย์
scenarioSentences: You need to send a package.
You cannot find the post office.
A man named Sam walks by.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi there. I'm lost. Where is the post office?

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: It's not far from here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. How do I get there?

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: Go straight down this road. Walk past the bank.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Past the bank. And then?

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: Turn left at the corner. The post office is beside a flower shop.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is it far to walk?

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: No, it's very close. But hurry, it closes at five.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oh, it's four thirty now. Thank you very much!

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: No problem. Good luck!

titleEn: Seeing the campus nurse for a cold
titleTh: ไปหาพยาบาลเพราะเป็นหวัด
scenarioSentences: Your throat hurts, and you have a headache.
You go to the health center.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello, Nurse Adams. I don't feel well today.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse Adams
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. What's the problem?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I have a sore throat and a headache.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse Adams
dialogue.text: When did it start?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yesterday evening. I didn't sleep well last night.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse Adams
dialogue.text: Let me check your temperature. It's a little high. You have a cold.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What can I do?

dialogue.speaker: Nurse Adams
dialogue.text: Rest at home and drink lots of water.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Can I go to class tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Nurse Adams
dialogue.text: Stay home tomorrow. Do you still feel bad on Friday? Then come back.

titleTh: ไปซื้อของกินประจำสัปดาห์
scenarioSentences: You both need food for the week.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Mia, there's nothing in the fridge. We need to go shopping.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's make a short list first.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. We need rice, chicken, and some vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: And bread and fruit, too.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How do we pay? Can we share the cost?

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Sure. Let's pay half each.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good. When can we go? I'm busy on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: What about Sunday morning? The market is cheaper than the supermarket.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, let's go to the market on Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Great. I'll bring the shopping bags.

titleEn: Buying tickets for a school concert
titleTh: ซื้อตั๋วคอนเสิร์ตของโรงเรียน
scenarioSentences: Your school has a concert next Friday.
You want to take a friend.
You go to the ticket desk.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Leo. I'd like tickets for the concert on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Sure. How many do you need?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Two, please. How much are they?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Normal tickets are fifteen dollars. Students pay ten.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: We're both students here. Here's my card.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Thanks. Where do you want to sit?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Near the front, please. Are there any good seats left?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Yes. There are two seats in row three, in the middle.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. I'll take them.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: That's twenty dollars. Enjoy the concert!
